channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: India-Pak T20 clash: BJP expresses confidence in victory, Cong slams match with terror state
item.description: The India–Pakistan T20 World Cup match has triggered strong political reactions in India. BJP leaders expressed confidence in India's victory, linking the contest to national pride. Congress leaders opposed the match, citing cross-border terrorism and the recent Pahalgam terror attack allegedly linked to Pakistan-based Lashkar-e-Taiba.

item.title: Union Budget focuses on strengthening MSMEs for scale, competitiveness and global reach
item.description: The Union Budget 2026–27 places MSMEs at the core of India's growth strategy, announcing measures to enhance their scale, competitiveness and global reach. MSMEs contribute 35.4% to manufacturing output, 48.58% to exports and 31.1% to GDP, employing over 32.82 crore people across 7.47 crore enterprises.

item.title: Strong global response to India AI Impact Summit 2026 highlights India's rise as a responsible AI hub
item.description: The summit will also unveil India's AI Governance Guidelines based on a 7-Sutra framework. Backed by the IndiaAI Mission, expanded compute capacity, and AI research initiatives, India aims to advance inclusive growth and responsible AI under its "AI for All" vision aligned with Viksit Bharat 2047.

item.title: Security tightened in J&K's Kathua, 5km border belt placed under restrictions
item.description: Amid intelligence inputs about cross-border infiltration attempts and drone-based smuggling from Pakistan, the Kathua administration has imposed restrictions within a five-kilometre belt along the International Border under Section 163 of the BNSS.

item.title: 'Call me to your wedding': Anuv Jain tells woman who proposed her boyfriend at his Mumbai concert
item.description: Singer Anuv Jain made Valentine's Day 2026 memorable in Mumbai during his Dastakhat World Tour when a woman surprised boyfriend with an on-stage proposal.

item.title: Political Storm in J&K Over MPLAD Funds Allocation to Uttar Pradesh
item.description: A political controversy has broken out in Jammu and Kashmir after reports alleged that Rajya Sabha MP Ghulam Ali Khatana allocated a major share of his MPLAD funds to projects in Uttar Pradesh instead of the UT he represents.

item.title: India's farmers 'betrayed' in US trade deal, Rahul Gandhi poses 5 questions; Amit Shah says interests fully safeguarded
item.description: Union Home Minister Amit Shah rejected the allegations, asserting that all trade agreements under Prime Minister Narendra Modi fully protect agriculture, dairy and fisheries. He accused Congress of misleading farmers, highlighted increased agriculture budgets and MSP procurement, and challenged Gandhi to a public debate.

item.title: India accounts for more than half of global digital transactions, says HM Amit Shah
item.description: The initiative includes the launch of the 'Annapurti' Grain ATM in Ahmedabad, capable of dispensing 25 kg of grains in 35 seconds, along with sealed distribution of pulses and the 'Garima Poshan' campaign. Shah said the model would be implemented nationwide within three to four years.

item.title: Cold stare at the toss: No handshake as India–Pakistan fireworks begin in Colombo
item.description: India made two changes, bringing back Abhishek Sharma and Kuldeep Yadav, while Pakistan retained their XI. The no-handshake stance drew criticism from former India cricketer Sanjay Manjrekar, who termed it "silly" and against the spirit of the game.

item.title: Mahashivratri 2026: Raveena Tandon, Akshay Kumar, Bhumi Pednekar, other celebs share photos
item.description: The festival of Maha Shivaratri is observed across the country with prayers, fasting, chanting of mantras, and visits to Shiva temples. Celebrities took to social media to extend their wishes to thier fans and devotees on the auspicious occasion via Instagram
